ratings_why.fun: The run-or-cash choice on Worn gives every midgame turn a real decision, and the late game has three different engines to reach; Tier 2 is thin, so early fights lean on what you copy.
ratings_why.distinct: Over a 7: Guise copies other tribes' text and tribe, so the tribe plays differently in every lobby and turns enemy and shop units into your pieces, which no current tribe does.

verdict_why: The rules now read and the tiers do their jobs; the remaining risks are numbers for the owner's balance pass, not design fixes.

points.text: Put Tam Twice's triple rule on its own line, as 'While this is on your board', so players don't read it as part of the When played.
Tier 2 has no unit that grows a board on its own; a small Changeling buffer there (say, End of Turn: give a Guised unit +1/+1 per turn Worn) would smooth turns 3 to 5.
Pip Unlike only matters for left/right or front/behind text; letting it also take the Guise of an enemy across would give it a job in more games.
Knowe Usher is the cash-in payoff for the Long Con; showing the pending applause on Guised cards would make the timing choice visible.

standouts.why: Keeper of the Lost Hour turns time into a resource you can stack and move, the clearest new decision in the tribe.
The Lady Under the Hill is a true capstone the board is built towards, and Hill of Ladies is a high roll worth chasing.
Exchange Assessor refills the board mid-fight with your killers' bodies, a great Tier 5 combat engine.

weakest.why: Pip Unlike's mirror only matters for directional text, so most games it is a plain Foundling at Tier 2.
Fetch of the Front Rank is only as good as the enemy across, and gives nothing permanent.
Grandfer Acorn's +1/+1 a turn is small for the tribe's only near-buffer at Tier 2.

flags.note: Each extra Lady (Moll Stock or Guise) multiplies every buff text again, so buffs grow with the square of Ladies; bounded by 7 slots but steep, more so golden.
Keeper piling Worn onto one unit feeds Knowe Usher's uncapped per-Worn payoff, and a Lady doubles it: one Unmask can be enormous.
Bettie has no limit; with Moll, Prentice, Clerk and the Assessor's mid-fight carves she can fire many times a turn and a fight.
Golden Wicker Moll makes a full-stat, full-text copy of your carry every turn, bounded only by board slots.
With Glamourer, Foundling and Stocks, Tam Twice can chain triples and Discovers from single copies each turn.
